verdict.rationale: Anytype ships first-party AI connectors. The official Anytype MCP Server lets AI assistants work with notes through natural language. The open-source Agents Skill lets Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and other agent tools read, search and modify Objects. Both run on a localhost API backed by a published, versioned OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these connectors work in practice; no evidence of a broader third-party AI plugin ecosystem.
